name: Masala Steak with Cardamom Roasted Root Veggies, Pistachios & Basil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 medium carrots
4 medium parsnips
½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and slice carrots and parsnips crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds. Transfer both to a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and honey, then season with cardamom and salt. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
4 tsp honey
1 ½ tsp cardamom, ground
salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't need to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g striploin (New York strip) steak
1 ½ tsp garam masala
salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add steak and grill until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer steak to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
While the steak is cooking, roughly chop pistachios.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and veggies between plates. Top veggies with pistachios and basil. Enjoy!
